attributes.name: Celestion
attributes.description: Celestions rarely appear from the void. Their wings emit a strange energy, which absorbs objects that get too close.

attributes.name: Solarion
attributes.description: Self sufficient and able to produce their own light, Solarions often live in solidarity

attributes.name: Mangris
attributes.description: A Mangris will confuse its prey with floral appendages. Once it is near, its saw-like front legs strike at the speed of sound.

attributes.name: Sporeleon
attributes.description: Sporeleons are often found perched high in the forest canopy, waiting for an unsuspecting meal to pass underneath.

attributes.name: Bazub
attributes.description: Bazub swarms are both deadly and destructive and can destroy entire croplands in mere minutes

attributes.name: Bolbon
attributes.description: A Bolbon can be inactive for so long that moss, shrubs, or even small trees grow on their backs and limbs.

attributes.name: Nocterra
attributes.description: Nocterra spread halucinogenic pollens which can severely disorient travellers and predators.

attributes.name: Lycospore
attributes.description: Lycospores release clouds of fine particles that shut down the immune systems of other living things.

attributes.name: Florean
attributes.description: Floreans root themselves to the ground and become immovable objects. Their vines are stronger than threaded steel, and often it is easier to move the earth itself.

attributes.name: Koranok
attributes.description: Koranok claws are powerful enough to burrow through permafrost and bedrock, where they build their nests in warm safety.

attributes.name: Sharakus
attributes.description: While swimming at full speed, a Sharakus generates enough energy to cause fifty-meter swells.

attributes.name: Sujin
attributes.description: Sujin are mischevious tricksters that are able to shape their watery bodies at will to mimic anything they have already seen

attributes.name: Leviathan
attributes.description: Leviathans usually drift throughout the dark abyss, their maws held open like black holes in the sea.

attributes.name: Seaqueen
attributes.description: The horns of Seaqueens are coated with a powerful toxin that can potentially paralyze a target or attacker for several days--if they survive the blow.

attributes.name: Naga
attributes.description: The Nagae have powerful, muscular bodies that enable them to manoeuvre swiftly and easily through water.

attributes.name: Mermos
attributes.description: Despite not having bones, each tentacle on a Mermos is capable of crushing a rock to beach sand.

attributes.name: Glacioise
attributes.description: Glacioises move so slowly that they are often mistaken for part of the glaciar.

attributes.name: Antarcticus
attributes.description: The wings of an Antarcticus emit a cold wind that cause dense clouds to erupt in snow.

attributes.name: Woover
attributes.description: Woovers travel in packs and chase down their prey over extremely long distances, or work together to set ambushes and traps.

attributes.name: Lavekans
attributes.description: Lavekans increase their elemental power when they are on firey ground, and often coil themselves up during combat to amplify that effect

attributes.name: Calidus
attributes.description: When a Calidus senses a threat, it begins to burn white hot and emits heatwaves that melt swords and char spears to black.

attributes.name: Magmus
attributes.description: Magmusii ooze a trail of lava wherever they go, which remains hot for many hours before cooling. This makes them easy to track in the wild--and even easier in cities.

attributes.name: Chargoyle
attributes.description: Chargoyles usually nest in groups on the sides of volcanoes. Easily startled, their manes erupt with flames in sychronicity as they take wing.

attributes.name: Firadactus
attributes.description: A Firadactus heats the air under its wings to aid its flight, allowing it to soar for many days without rest.

attributes.name: Ignis
attributes.description: When harmed or threatened, a Ignis emits a strong odor that alerts its hive to the presence of invaders. Soon, there are many buzzing flames and red hot stingers.

attributes.name: Blazeo
attributes.description: If threatened, Blazeos fan out their burning tails to shield themselves from attacks and obscure their image.

attributes.name: Phoenix
attributes.description: When a Phoenix sheds its feathers, the discarded plumage continues to burn until the end of its cycle, even if placed underwater.

attributes.name: Flamus
attributes.description: A Flamus must always be on the move, lest it melts the ground it stands upon.

attributes.name: Goblen
attributes.description: Goblens are social creatures that work in large groups. Although small, their voices carry over heat and can extend many miles in the right conditions.

attributes.name: Depedus
attributes.description: Depedusae cause small earthquakes as they build their complex tunnel networks. They are believed to live at the bottom of the world's crust in perpetual heat, pressure, and darkness.

attributes.name: Darthys
attributes.description: Whenever something dies near a Darthys, its soul risks being trapped in the crystal on the Darthys' back forever.

attributes.name: Wraith
attributes.description: The claws of Wraiths are massive and terrifying, but their slash is the legend of stories, which put kids to bed in fear.

attributes.name: Wanderer
attributes.description: Wanderers are said to be powerful warrior spirits that travel the world in desperate search for a worthy opponent.

attributes.name: Baphomet
attributes.description: Baphomets are highly deceptive shapeshifters that commit to their disguises at great lengths, sometimes posing as another being for a full lifetime.

attributes.name: Sentinel
attributes.description: Because they have no desires of their own, Sentinels stand guard at attention indefinitely. They are the perfect soldiers.

attributes.name: Elkar
attributes.description: The glowing gold antlers of Elkari are used for mating rituals and courtship combat. Elkari are sometimes found to be training against large boulders and can turn a mountainside to rubble.

attributes.name: Lumenicia
attributes.description: Highly sensitive to the world and its vibrations, Lumeniciae communicate through photons of light.

attributes.name: Gryphon
attributes.description: Gryphons whip their tails to send shockwaves of air that stun and shatter with sound on impact.

attributes.name: Pegasus
attributes.description: Pegasusies gallop through the night sky, wherefore they are commonly mistaken for falling stars.

attributes.name: Templar
attributes.description: Templars have powerful wings that allow for sudden take-off and blurring flight. They cannot be caught--only trapped and befriended.

attributes.name: Almega
attributes.description: Almega can see into the near future and predict upcoming attacks. They seem to ignore the laws of space-time.

attributes.name: Kaiborg
attributes.description: The Kaiborgs promised never to return to dust, so they created new selves of metal.

attributes.name: Badara
attributes.description: Its speed and strength are amplified in the moonlight. After sunset, there is little to nothing that can stop a Badara.

attributes.name: Omnipotens
attributes.description: In times of peace, they sleep in the shadows and wait. In the end of times, they shake the heavens with pillars of white light.

attributes.name: Bamboozler
attributes.description: Although they might appear slow and simple, Bamboozlers are known to attack aggressively with quick combos of punches and kicks.

attributes.name: Slobloom
attributes.description: Sloblooms are notorious for picking fights with those who deny their beauty.

attributes.name: Lunashroom
attributes.description: A Lunashroom is a solitary monster with toxic fungi on its head and back for defense. They can emit fatal nitrogenous clouds from their breath.

attributes.name: Florean
attributes.description: Floreans move quickly through the air and disorient attackers with their stunning beauty and pollenated displays.

attributes.name: Absolopede
attributes.description: In spite of its intimidating size, Absaloms are unusually friendly even in the wild. They are prone to hugging and often refuse to let go, which can be unintentionally fatal.

attributes.name: Carathorn
attributes.description: These strange monsters pretend to be part of the forest. The Carathorn hunts via movement, so remaining calm is the best defense against its long, spiked horn and venomous gaze.

attributes.name: Terassus
attributes.description: This prehistoric monster survives through the vitality of the forest and the beauty of its flowers. It tramples anyone or anything that threatens its trees and meadows, for the Terassus bears the weight of life.

attributes.name: Turtapollen
attributes.description: The Turtapollen is a prehistoric monster that erupts with blinding and choking pollen. Its shell is harder than diamond, and it sparkles with the ancient power of the forest.

attributes.name: Vindroll
attributes.description: A stealthy, carnivorous plant that appears as a beautiful shrub. It ambushes its prey by unleashing sharp blades of grass in fierce and quick attacks.

attributes.name: Pongo
attributes.description: These powerful cyclopic monsters are able to move through the forest unnoticed. They are highly sentient and make tools and weapons with large branches.

attributes.name: Mancia
attributes.description: Mancia are usually found hanging down on jungle branches waiting to catch unsuspecting prey with their tentacle like petals

attributes.name: Buzzkill
attributes.description: The herculean Buzzkill is a knightly force unto itself, capable of rapid flight, opponents who are shown mercy often only remember a loud buzzing blur before darkness.

attributes.name: Lignicia
attributes.description: Lignicia are usually deep in the forests and camouflage so well, they are often not seen or heard, many wonder if they exist at all

attributes.name: Growilla
attributes.description: Growillas are territorial like many other primates. Despite their size, they are very agile and will display tremendous speed and strength when threatened.

attributes.name: Tronk
attributes.description: Tronks are feral forest monsters who spend their youths in search of the perfect fighting log. Although not especially blood-thirsty, their competitiveness and athletic vigor often leads to rough housing.

attributes.name: Pumelkin
attributes.description: Pumelkins are aggressive monsters who aspire to compete in hatchy tournaments. They are easily pocketed by worthy Summoners but will fight ferociously against those it deems unworthy.

attributes.name: Shrubasaur
attributes.description: Shrubasaurs live in underground burrows and are often found in tall grass. These herbivores can change their skin color and texture to match the environment, even appearing as a leafless tree.

attributes.name: Rhynocker
attributes.description: Rhynockers dwell on the edges of forests and defend their territories with devastating charges. These large monsters will roll and lift boulders with their horns to form small caves for their young.

attributes.name: Behemoth
attributes.description:
Fast, ferocious, and voracious, a Behemoth is most dangerous when pushed against the ropes. As a last resort, these monsters deploy their powerful stingers and weaken themselves to paralyze their opponents. 
 paralyze his opponent, although this attack will leave him very weak.

attributes.name: Leaffur
attributes.description: Leaffurs travel as large families throughout the forest and defend themselves with surprising strength and courage. They are very protective of their Summoners and will often pre-emptively attack a perceived opponent.

attributes.name: Boppelsmash
attributes.description: The Boppelsmash is an extremely athletic monster that jumps high in the air before crashing downward. Its impact creates small-scale tremors that can disorient its opponents.

attributes.name: Biguana
attributes.description: Biguana are agile fighters with powerful tails and fast kicks. Each Biguana develops its own fighting style, making them tough to predict.

attributes.name: Kalobber
attributes.description: Although it may appear lumbering and soft, a Kalobber eats leaves high up in trees, ready to drop down on unwary intruders.

attributes.name: Hadrowhip
attributes.description: Hadrowhips shoot high-pressure water beams that whip across the waves and pierce through sheets of metal.

attributes.name: Psyren
attributes.description: Psyrens are shy hatchies that usually avoid humans. They are found in small groups on exposed sea rocks, where their singing ironically attracts others to their beautiful sounds.

attributes.name: Tentakill
attributes.description: Usually solitary in nature, a Tentakill has eight venemous tentacles and two strong arms that paralyze and immobilize their prey.

attributes.name: Clashsicle
attributes.description: Able to move quickly through ice sheets and snow drifts, Clashicles channel water energy into sharp spears and projectiles.

attributes.name: Platasaur
attributes.description: Platasaurs blast powerful streams of bubbles with their mouth that can knock down or incapacitate their opponents.

attributes.name: Swordsnout
attributes.description: Swordsnouts pierce through the ocean with their sharp beak-like noses and can swim great distances at top speed without relenting. They are fierce rivals against Sharakusii.

attributes.name: Ramsplash
attributes.description: Ramsplashies gather enough speed and power to launch their target high enough into the air that the surface tension feels like concrete.

attributes.name: Jabberwelt
attributes.description: Jabberwelts are strange Hatchies, known to perform dance-like rituals, punching exhibitions, and rap battles to impress trainers they admire and mates they desire.

attributes.name: Crocodiver
attributes.description: Silent stalkers of rivers and shores, a Crocodiver will sometimes wait patiently among the green shallows for many days before striking.

attributes.name: Hydroslam
attributes.description: Sometimes called "River Horses Plus," Hydroslams are not as cute and cuddly as they may appear. In fact, they are powerful waterwalkers, whose body slams splash even large ships from the water.

attributes.name: Tidalhorse
attributes.description: Although shy and aloof, a loyal Tidalhorse serves as a tremendous water steed and life-long friend. Many Tidalhorses outlive their trainers and become part of the family.

attributes.name: Magentic
attributes.description: Fiercely loyal and regal to the core, Magentics display both chivalry and style when they fight. Honor, Courage, Might. These are their oaths.

attributes.name: Malclam
attributes.description: Malclams shoot powerful beams of light that penetrate the dark and heavy deeps. They emerge from the deeps only to recharge in the sunlight of the Sky Egg.

attributes.name: Frosloth
attributes.description: Frosloths are powerful creatures that burrow deep into the permafrost to hibernate. It is never recommended to interrupt their slumber.

attributes.name: Arcticlaw
attributes.description: The howling of Arcticlaws can be heard in the evening and ealy morning hours. They move and hunt in large and highly-organized packs.

attributes.name: Painguin
attributes.description: The sharp head-feathers of a Painguin can slice through any surface. Although voracious in the water, it is rather awkward and clumsy on dry land. With the right amount of fresh fish, they are easy to tame and train.

attributes.name: Krabsmack
attributes.description: A Krabsmack can exert enough pressure with its powerful claws to snap even the toughest prey in half. What is more, it uses sensitive antennae to predict incoming attacks.

attributes.name: Snowsquatch
attributes.description: Snowsquatches are known for wielding snowballs with incredible force. They are believed to cause avalanches.

attributes.name: Riptyde
attributes.description: Once drawn into combat, there is no escape from a Riptyde. Their massive arms and powerful forms crush and drown all those who swim in their way.

attributes.name: Eelectra
attributes.description: Eelectras are shockingly potent and surprisingly slippery in combat. When in water, their bolts of electricity are magnified and projected for a great distance.

attributes.name: Anchorvie
attributes.description: Though seldom seen above the surface, Anchorvies inspired humans to craft shipweights called anchors.

attributes.name: Speartle
attributes.description: Speartles live in large, war-like communities that migrate throughout the seasons via underwater rivers. When a Spurtle evolves into a Speartle, it uses its indestructible shell as a round shield.

attributes.name: Coreeko
attributes.description: Coreekos may appear like colorful plants in shallows and reefs, but they become fierce fighters when nibbled on by larger fish and water Hatchies.

attributes.name: Lunamander
attributes.description: A distant cousin of the Solamander, the Lunamander is a nocturnal hunter of large insects. It is highly resistant to venoms and poisons of both plants and creatures.

attributes.name: Minotorch
attributes.description: Large herds of Minotorches can be found on the lava fields and magmatic plains near firebergs. Their blazing stampedes can be felt for miles all around.

attributes.name: Scythepaw
attributes.description: Fast, agile, and ferocious, Scythepaws strike and slash from every direction and angle in combat. When they are not sleeping, they are reaping.

attributes.name: Butterflame
attributes.description: Related to Fireflies, the Butterflame is an elusive creature that lives within volcanoes and floats from fireflowers to magmapies.

attributes.name: Asheater
attributes.description: Contrary to popular belief, Asheaters do not eat burnt wood, but rather consume red ants, fire ants, and magmants in their ashen burrows.

attributes.name: Embird
attributes.description: Embirds spend much of their lives both finding and collecting new logs for their nests, which always burn down in short time.

attributes.name: Candlekin
attributes.description: Candlekins are fiery little Hatchies who burn brighter as they get angrier.

attributes.name: Charbeast
attributes.description: Powerful and wise, a Charbeast spends much of its time in meditation and thought. They dwell in caves on the sides of volcanoes.

attributes.name: Taurrid
attributes.description: Taurrids are solitary creatures in the wild. Even their own reflection makes them boil with red rage.

attributes.name: Brunner
attributes.description: They burn when they run, and they run when they burn. Therefore, they never stop brunning.

attributes.name: Flaemu
attributes.description: Flaemus are fast and noisy Hatchies who scorch the ground when they run. Although flightless, their feathers burn so hot that they must flap them continually.

attributes.name: Firazel
attributes.description: The favorite activity of Firazels includes hiking to the top of a volcano and bellyflopping into the magma far below.

attributes.name: Emberslash
attributes.description: Do not approach an Emberslash during heat. In other words, never approach an Emberslash in the wild.

attributes.name: Blasthopper
attributes.description: Rule #35 in Hatchy World: There is never just one Blasthopper.

attributes.name: Kungferno
attributes.description: A Kungferno begins its training as a Hatchling and does not stop until it has mastered the arts of Karhoty.

attributes.name: Pyren
attributes.description: The pious priests called Pyrens dance on the tumultuous magmatic waves of inner volcanoes.

attributes.name: Flamane
attributes.description: Sometimes referred to as "maneiacs," the Flamane is a short but hot-tempered Hatchy with surprisingly agility and acrobatic abilities.

attributes.name: Hotweiler
attributes.description: Hotweilers in the wild may be ferocious and untrusting, but they are fiercely loyal and protective of their beloved trainers.

attributes.name: Bunsin
attributes.description: Few things burn hotter than a Bunsin, for which reason they are used to ignite large bunfires.

attributes.name: Magmadon
attributes.description: The Magmadon is one of the most feared wild Hatchies on the sides of volcanoes. They use their heads to smash and their large legs to stomp any intruder.

attributes.name: Firret
attributes.description: Firrets are pesky Hatchies that steal food from unwary travelers. They travel in groups and use distraction tactics.

attributes.name: Incineraptor
attributes.description: Incineraptors travel in large packs, working together to bring down large prey. Not even dragons are considered too dangerous for these hellish Hatchies to torment.

attributes.name: Warmanger
attributes.description: The fireptiles called Warmangers are hot-blooded and hotter tempered. It is difficult to distinguish their angry hissing from the escaping gases of magma.

attributes.name: Diamoxius
attributes.description: The large horn of the Diamoxius strikes fear and death into all who disturb its darkness.

attributes.name: Lucifell
attributes.description: Once the brightest of Hatchies in the world, the Lucifellae lost their light and cast themselves into the shadows of the deeps.

attributes.name: Doomcade
attributes.description: Once every ten years, the Doomcadae awaken from their slumbers in the forest and emerge in dark swarms that choke the sunlight of the Sky Egg.

attributes.name: Shadarkan
attributes.description: Shadarkans are mysterious Hatchies with unclear ambitions. They enjoy riddles, tongue twisters, and obscure prophecies.

attributes.name: Noxi
attributes.description: When Noxii gather, their plumes of toxic gas become insurmountable and devastating. Even the most viruelent creatures avoid these noxious gatherings.

attributes.name: Toadeth
attributes.description: The slimy skin of a Toadeth is so poisonous that it inspired the vow: "Toadeth do us part."

attributes.name: Dreamphibian
attributes.description: The Dreamphibian uses sound and movement to hypnotize its prey into a trance like state.

attributes.name: Murcial
attributes.description: Murcials are fast and use deadly poisons they gather and trade amongst each other

attributes.name: Leechblight
attributes.description: Leechblights are dangerous and should be avoided in the wild. When they latch onto prey, they suck the strength from their forms until pale and weak.

attributes.name: Hypnoshade
attributes.description: Hypnoshades are devious tricksters that play tricks on people for sheer amusement. It's all fun and games as long as someone loses an eye.

attributes.name: Toxiloris
attributes.description: A Toxiloris will use its large tail to launch itself on a target. A single sting from the toxic barbs on its horn causes painful paralysis and short breath.

attributes.name: Bristlebain
attributes.description: Bristlebains camouflage themselves like stones in the shade. Stepping on one of their spikes is the last wrong-step that a traveler can make.

attributes.name: Abydon
attributes.description: Abydons disappear into shadows and stalk their prey as silently as death itself.

attributes.name: Doomhopper
attributes.description: A herd of Doomhoppers is called a storm because they sound like rolling thunder across the horizon.

attributes.name: Loprogard
attributes.description: These guardians are found near the Temple of Light. Loprogards are able to sense the intentions of those who approach them.

attributes.name: Dawnclaw
attributes.description: Rising early to hunt in the twilight, a Dawnclaw cuts through the undergrowth with its razor sharp nails.

attributes.name: Pixelite
attributes.description: Pixelites spend their evenings in tall grasses and wide meadows, where they glow in fluttering dance.

attributes.name: Raydon
attributes.description: The slashing claws of a Raydon are as piercing as morning light and twice as blinding.

attributes.name: Blitzard
attributes.description: Blitzards are lightning-fast Hatchies that use their powerful tails to propel themselves away from danger or towards a meal.

attributes.name: Knightlight
attributes.description: Knightlights are fierce warriors who belong to fraternal orders. Their code demands a lifetime of sacrifice against chaos.

attributes.name: Flutterflight
attributes.description: Flutterflights are gentle and lovable Hatchies that dwell in flowerfields and grasslands. They are a favorite household friend of humans in Hatchy World.

attributes.name: Briteling
attributes.description: Considered to be extremely lucky, Britelings are sought out by humans because a simple look in their direction brings two weeks good fortune.

attributes.name: Pharoclops
attributes.description: Pharaclops are solitary Hatchies who practice the powerful arts of the third-eye. They see what most others cannot.

attributes.name: Owluminate
attributes.description: Owluminates are nocturnal creatures that can dim themselves while hunting. Once their prey is caught, however, they glow brightly to warn away other would-be scavengers.

attributes.name: Gaeltus
attributes.description: Its bronze beak and razor sharp talons make the Gaeltus a fearsome predator in the skies. Gaeltus feathers are so sharply thin that chefs use them for kitchen knives.

attributes.name: Seraphump
attributes.description: Seraphumps are slow-moving and sedentary in nature. Only when hungry do they move with a sense of urgency.

attributes.name: Airsupial
attributes.description: Airsupials are so light in body and mind that clouds form underneath and carry them across the vaults of the sky.

attributes.name: Skyren
attributes.description: Like their elemental cousins, the Skyrens are powerful conjurers of the energies that fill each domain.

attributes.name: Tarragonus
attributes.description: Believed to have been created by the primordial demigods of the Plant Hatchies, a Tarragonus can summon a forest at will.

attributes.name: Frostvern
attributes.description: Wherever a Frostvern chooses to nest, the land experiences a perpetual winter without growth.

attributes.name: Firadra
attributes.description: Firadra are believed to live deep in the world's core, sleeping in the molten seas of rock.

attributes.name: Blasilisk
attributes.description: Blasilisk horns are equipped with deadly poisons and acids that can eat through any material known to man.

attributes.name: Lucirrus
attributes.description: Luccirrus unleashes powerful beams of light from its mouth that carve mountain ranges into valleys and plains.

attributes.name: Negato
attributes.description: The Void Spirit created the race of Negatos with special intent and gifted them the ability to bend space and time.

there are 4 factions
- the order - sects secretly united under a ruler
- the omni - the unitarians
- the techies - mostly selfish or self absorbed -  neutral

attributes.name: The Undead Corruption

attributes.agenda: To spread the corruption and create the abyssal horde and control all chaos in creation

attributes.name: The Dark Brotherhood
attributes.description: The Dark Brotherhood is a group of assassins and thieves who seek to control the world from the shadows
attributes.agenda: To gain power and control over the world

attributes.name: the empire
attributes.description: an aging monarch desperate to maintain its hold on power
attributes.agenda: to recover its lost lands and return to its former glory, to conquer the entire world

attributes.name: Kingdom of Azura
attributes.description: technological scientific people pushing for superiority, creating conflict in ethics and fighting for resources to fuel their hungry tech
attributes.agenda: maintaining their prosperity and independence, bringing freedom to more people

attributes.name: togenkyo monastery village
attributes.description: minimalist fighter monks

attributes.name: political nomads
attributes.description: detached from the land they are convinced to destroy the lands they are in for wealth, they turn against the others to get their way
attributes.agenda: control of the region, wealth and power

attributes.name: religious nomads
attributes.description: traditional people living spiritual lives on the plains, they feel a responsibility to the ecosystem and try to avoid actions that can cause harm
attributes.agenda: maintaining their prosperity and independence, living harmoniously with the land

attributes.name: realm guard
attributes.description: politically agnostic order of elite warriors from around the world sworn to the protection of the realm against major threats
attributes.agenda: to maintain control and ensure there is no political threat while maintaining diplomacy to request resources, with at least an ambassador from representing each nation in the order

attributes.name: priests
attributes.description: a religious group of priest monks who travel the world compiling knowledge and running various services
attributes.agenda:
some people have been hijacked in by the order, theyve added their own information to the main directives

theyve taken some of the directives and layered on extra commandments that are a bit more sectarian, being used to reinforce divisions

attributes.name: The Order of the Light
attributes.description: The Order of the Light is a group of fanatical warrior knights who are sworn to protect the realm until the return of the prophet
attributes.agenda: To protect the world from darkness and chaos

attributes.name: merchants guild
attributes.description: global trade management
attributes.agenda: try to maintain global trade management and funnels money to capital

attributes.name: ahahin
attributes.description: bit darker, usually involved in nefarious things, controlled by crime gang(dark brotherhood)

attributes.description: The Immortal Being

attributes.name: The Wise Old Mentor
attributes.description: The Wise Old Mentor
attributes.subplot: A mentor figure who imparts important knowledge and guidance to the protagonist

attributes.name: The Trickster
attributes.description: The Trickster
attributes.subplot: A mischievous and unpredictable character who often acts as a foil to the protagonist

attributes.name: The Femme Fatale
attributes.description: The Femme Fatale
attributes.subplot: A seductive and dangerous woman who uses her charms to manipulate others

attributes.name: The Beast
attributes.description: The Beast
attributes.subplot: A powerful and dangerous creature that is often a symbol of primal nature

attributes.name: The Prophet
attributes.description: The Prophet
attributes.subplot: A visionary or religious figure who provides insight into the future or spiritual realm

attributes.subplot: A ruthless general in the Dominion's army, Viktor is driven by a desire for power and control. He sees democracy as a weakness, and views the Dominion's rule as the only way to maintain order and stability in the world.
